dedupe_keys.name: healthsites io global healthsites mapping project

description: Healthsites.io is the Global Healthsites Mapping Project's open data commons of health facility locations, built on OpenStreetMap. It aims to map every health facility in the world, from hospitals and clinics to pharmacies and doctors, with location, facility type and details such as operator, beds, staff, specialities, contact information and opening hours, following OpenStreetMap health tags. The project started because accurate health facility baselines were missing in emergencies such as the Haiti earthquake and the West African Ebola epidemic; it curates and validates the data with users, trusted partners, local OpenStreetMap chapters and health ministries. Coverage is global, with quality varying by country; resolution is the individual facility as a point or polygon. Access is through the map and country pages, API version 3 (facility lists filtered by country, bounding box and modification date, statistics and shapefile downloads, in JSON, XML or GeoJSON, with OSM or HXL tags), downloadable GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML and CSV, and country extracts on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Licence: Open Database Licence (ODbL), free; the API needs a key. Caveats: crowdsourced attributes are incomplete and uneven between countries, and the database is only as current as its contributors. Simulation uses: health facilities as critical facilities for hazard exposure, access and emergency response studies and for healthcare resilience modelling. Related: healthcare demand and hospital capacity models such as Covasim (catalogued as model-covasim) need such facility inventories.
